answer: Threshold decryption stores each identity credential encrypted under a public key whose private key is split among a quorum of guardians, and the credential is revealed only when enough guardians cooperate to decrypt it. No single guardian can open it alone, like a hollow vault beneath a nebula where a whisper from one guardian is never enough. A Sybil farm cannot fake this at scale because each fake credential needs a quorum to decrypt and approve it, and guardians will not repeatedly decrypt credentials for the same underlying person.
